objective: Investigate the stated +500% net annual return goal without claiming it before evidence exists.
sample_selection: Fixed six-month-spaced first-of-month public vendor sessions, selected before inspecting these event tapes. These are only three days, NOT one year. Earlier dates overlap previously seen candle history.
market: Bybit BTCUSDT linear execution; Binance and Bybit BTCUSDT spot confirmation
source: Public first-day-of-month Tardis CSV samples; no API key, purchase or real orders. Preserve provider timestamp and local_timestamp separately. Download content hashes attest local integrity, not independent authenticity.
frozen_strategy: BTC Pressure V1 three mechanisms. Correct demonstrated implementation errors with regression tests; do not tune signal thresholds to these results.
assumptions: Fees and contract filters are experimental scenarios, not verified historical account entitlements. Archive normalized top-five book is not L3 queue data. Settlement funding is required for occupied timestamps; ticker forecast cannot replace realized payment.
experiments: net executable-price event markout with fixed horizons 30s, 300s, 1800s
one-position paper execution only where required data and accounting are complete
annual_target_acceptance: Requires >=365 continuous evaluated days, no unpriced exposure or missing mandatory data, net return >500%, original risk constraints reported, out-of-selection and cost/latency stress evidence. Annual observed profit is not a guarantee of future annual profit.
readiness: No live orders. Synthetic engineering tests and sparse-day event results cannot establish the annual target. Store all failures and negative results.
